import { animate, motion, useMotionValue, useReducedMotion, useReducedMotionConfig, useTransform } from 'motion/react'
import { type KeyboardEvent, type MouseEvent, type PointerEvent, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

/** OS setting, or forced on with <MotionConfig reducedMotion="always">. */
function usePrefersReducedMotion() {
  const os = useReducedMotion()
  const forced = useReducedMotionConfig()
  return Boolean(os || forced)
}

const EASE_OUT = [0.23, 1, 0.32, 1] as const
const EASE_IN_OUT = [0.65, 0, 0.35, 1] as const
const HEIGHT = 56
const INSET = 4
const THUMB = HEIGHT - INSET * 2
/** Share of the track the thumb must cross before letting go commits. */
const COMMIT_AT = 0.9
/** A flick this fast (px/s) commits from FLICK_FROM of the way along. */
const FLICK_SPEED = 900
const FLICK_FROM = 0.45
/** How far past either end the thumb stretches, at most. */
const OVERDRAG = 8
/** A press that moves less than this is a tap. */
const TAP_SLOP = 4

type Phase = 'idle' | 'dragging' | 'confirming' | 'done'

export interface SlideToConfirmProps {
  /** What sliding does, e.g. 'Slide to send 0.25 ETH'. */
  label?: string
  /** Read out while `onConfirm` runs. */
  confirmingLabel?: string
  /** Shown once it is done, e.g. 'Sent'. */
  doneLabel?: string
  /** The real work. Return a promise to keep the spinner up until it settles; a rejection sends the thumb back. */
  onConfirm?: () => Promise<unknown> | unknown
  /** Seconds before it goes back to the start once done. `null` stays done. */
  resetAfter?: number | null
  /** Minimum seconds the busy state shows, so a fast handler does not flash the spinner. */
  duration?: number
  disabled?: boolean
  className?: string
}

const wait = (ms: number) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms))

// Past the ends the thumb follows less and less, so it stretches instead of stopping dead.
function band(raw: number, max: number) {
  if (raw > max) return max + OVERDRAG * (1 - Math.exp(-(raw - max) / 40))
  if (raw < 0) return -OVERDRAG * (1 - Math.exp(raw / 40))
  return raw
}

/** A hold-to-commit slider for irreversible actions. Drag it, or press Enter, Space or the right arrow. */
export function SlideToConfirm({
  label = 'Slide to confirm',
  confirmingLabel = 'Confirming',
  doneLabel = 'Confirmed',
  onConfirm,
  resetAfter = 2.6,
  duration = 0.8,
  disabled = false,
  className,
}: SlideToConfirmProps) {
  const reduced = usePrefersReducedMotion()
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>('idle')
  const [armed, setArmed] = useState(false)

  const trackRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const dragRef = useRef({ pointer: 0, from: 0, moved: false })
  const runRef = useRef(0)
  const confirmRef = useRef(onConfirm)
  confirmRef.current = onConfirm

  const x = useMotionValue(0)
  const width = useMotionValue(0)
  // 0: the ink ends at the thumb. 1: it fills the whole track.
  const cover = useMotionValue(0)

  const max = () => Math.max(0, width.get() - THUMB - INSET * 2)

  const fillClip = useTransform(
    [x, width, cover],
    ([value, total, covered]: number[]) =>
      `inset(0px ${(1 - covered) * Math.max(0, total - value - INSET - THUMB / 2)}px 0px 0px round ${HEIGHT}px)`,
  )
  // Hidden at rest, so no ink shows round the thumb before it moves.
  const fillOpacity = useTransform(x, (value) => Math.min(1, value / 20))
  const labelOpacity = useTransform([x, width], ([value, total]: number[]) => {
    const progress = value / Math.max(1, total - THUMB - INSET * 2)
    return Math.max(0, 1 - progress * 0.55)
  })

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const track = trackRef.current
    if (!track || typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') return
    const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => {
      const before = width.get()
      width.set(track.offsetWidth)
      // Keep a thumb that sits at the end at the end when the track resizes.
      if (before > 0 && x.get() >= before - THUMB - INSET * 2) x.set(track.offsetWidth - THUMB - INSET * 2)
    })
    observer.observe(track)
    return () => observer.disconnect()
  }, [width, x])

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      runRef.current += 1
    },
    [],
  )

  const spring = (velocity = 0) =>
    reduced
      ? { duration: 0, ease: EASE_OUT }
      : { type: 'spring' as const, stiffness: 520, damping: 42, velocity }

  const settleBack = (velocity = 0) => {
    setArmed(false)
    setPhase('idle')
    animate(cover, 0, { duration: reduced ? 0 : 0.3, ease: EASE_OUT })
    animate(x, 0, spring(velocity))
  }

  const rewind = () => {
    setArmed(false)
    setPhase('idle')
    const d = reduced ? 0 : 0.6
    animate(cover, 0, { duration: d * 0.6, ease: EASE_OUT })
    animate(x, 0, { duration: d, ease: EASE_IN_OUT })
  }

  // One motion from release to result: the thumb carries on to the end while the ink floods
  // the track, and the work starts at once instead of waiting for the thumb to land.
  const commit = async (velocity: number, glide = false) => {
    const run = ++runRef.current
    const alive = () => runRef.current === run
    setPhase('confirming')
    setArmed(true)

    const landing = animate(x, max(), glide && !reduced ? { duration: 0.42, ease: EASE_IN_OUT } : spring(velocity))
    const flooding = animate(cover, 1, { duration: reduced ? 0 : 0.36, ease: EASE_OUT })

    try {
      await Promise.all([confirmRef.current?.(), reduced ? undefined : wait(duration * 1000), landing, flooding])
    } catch {
      if (alive()) settleBack()
      return
    }
    if (!alive()) return
    setPhase('done')
    if (resetAfter === null) return
    await wait(resetAfter * 1000)
    if (alive()) rewind()
  }

  const onPointerDown = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (disabled || phase !== 'idle' || event.button !== 0) return
    event.currentTarget.setPointerCapture?.(event.pointerId)
    x.stop()
    dragRef.current = { pointer: event.clientX, from: x.get(), moved: false }
    setPhase('dragging')
  }

  const onPointerMove = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (phase !== 'dragging') return
    const drag = dragRef.current
    const delta = event.clientX - drag.pointer
    if (Math.abs(delta) > TAP_SLOP) drag.moved = true
    const raw = drag.from + delta
    x.set(band(raw, max()))
    const isArmed = raw >= max() * COMMIT_AT
    if (isArmed !== armed) setArmed(isArmed)
  }

  const onPointerUp = () => {
    if (phase !== 'dragging') return
    if (!dragRef.current.moved) {
      setPhase('idle')
      return
    }
    const velocity = x.getVelocity()
    const progress = x.get() / Math.max(1, max())
    const flicked = velocity > FLICK_SPEED && progress > FLICK_FROM
    if (progress >= COMMIT_AT || flicked) commit(velocity)
    else settleBack(velocity)
  }

  const onClick = async (event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (disabled || phase !== 'idle') return
    // Enter and Space click with no pointer, and confirm in one go.
    if (event.detail === 0) {
      commit(0, true)
      return
    }
    if (dragRef.current.moved || reduced) return
    // A tap shows which way to go: a short nudge that springs back.
    await animate(x, 28, { duration: 0.18, ease: EASE_OUT })
    animate(x, 0, spring())
  }

  const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    if (event.key !== 'ArrowRight') return
    event.preventDefault()
    if (!disabled && phase === 'idle') commit(0, true)
  }

  const done = phase === 'done'
  const busy = phase === 'confirming'
  const stageLabel = busy ? `${confirmingLabel}…` : done ? doneLabel : label

  return (
    <div className={cn('relative w-full max-w-sm select-none', className)} data-phase={phase}>
      <div
        ref={trackRef}
        className={cn('relative overflow-hidden rounded-full border border-border bg-muted', disabled && 'opacity-50')}
        style={{ height: HEIGHT }}
      >
        <motion.span
          aria-hidden
          className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center whitespace-nowrap pl-6 text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground"
          style={{ opacity: labelOpacity }}
        >
          {label}
        </motion.span>

        {/* The ink the thumb leaves behind, with the label on it. It turns green when done. */}
        <motion.div
          aria-hidden
          className={cn(
            'absolute inset-0 transition-colors duration-300 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none',
            done ? 'bg-[var(--success)]' : 'bg-foreground',
          )}
          style={{ clipPath: fillClip, opacity: fillOpacity }}
        >
          <span
            key={stageLabel}
            className={cn(
              'absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap text-sm font-medium text-background',
              phase === 'idle' || phase === 'dragging' ? 'pl-6' : 'pr-6',
            )}
          >
            {stageLabel}
          </span>
        </motion.div>

        <motion.button
          type="button"
          disabled={disabled}
          aria-label={`${label}. Press Enter to confirm.`}
          aria-busy={busy}
          className={cn(
            'absolute flex touch-none items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-background text-foreground shadow-sm outline-none ring-1 ring-border',
            'focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-muted',
            phase === 'idle' && !disabled && 'cursor-grab',
            phase === 'dragging' && 'cursor-grabbing',
            disabled && 'cursor-not-allowed',
          )}
          onClick={onClick}
          onKeyDown={onKeyDown}
          onPointerCancel={onPointerUp}
          onPointerDown={onPointerDown}
          onPointerMove={onPointerMove}
          onPointerUp={onPointerUp}
          // Offsets are from inside the 1px border.
          style={{ x, left: INSET - 1, top: INSET - 1, width: THUMB, height: THUMB }}
        >
          <span aria-hidden className="relative size-5">
            <svg
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="2"
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              className={cn(
                'absolute inset-0 size-5 transition-[opacity,translate] duration-200 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none',
                armed && !busy && !done && 'translate-x-0.5',
                (busy || done) && 'translate-x-1.5 opacity-0',
              )}
            >
              <path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6" />
            </svg>
            <svg
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              fill="none"
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeWidth="2.5"
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              className={cn(
                'absolute inset-0 size-5 text-[var(--success)] transition-[opacity,scale] duration-200 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none',
                done ? 'scale-100 opacity-100' : 'scale-50 opacity-0',
              )}
            >
              <path d="m5 12.5 4.5 4.5L19 7.5" />
            </svg>
            <svg
              viewBox="0 0 24 24"
              className={cn(
                'absolute -inset-0.5 size-6 transition-opacity duration-200',
                !reduced && 'animate-spin [animation-duration:700ms]',
                busy ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0',
              )}
            >
              <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" fill="none" strokeWidth="2.5" className="stroke-border" />
              <circle
                cx="12"
                cy="12"
                r="9"
                fill="none"
                strokeWidth="2.5"
                strokeDasharray="14 43"
                strokeLinecap="round"
                className="stroke-current"
              />
            </svg>
          </span>
        </motion.button>
      </div>

      <span aria-live="polite" role="status" className="sr-only">
        {busy && `${confirmingLabel}…`}
        {done && doneLabel}
      </span>
    </div>
  )
}

import { SlideToConfirm } from '@/components/slide-to-confirm'

export default function SlideToConfirmDemo() {
  return (
    <div className="w-[min(92vw,380px)] rounded-2xl border bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground shadow-sm">
      <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Send</p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-3xl font-semibold tabular-nums tracking-tight">0.25 ETH</p>
      <dl className="mt-4 mb-6 space-y-2 border-t pt-4 text-sm">
        <div className="flex justify-between">
          <dt className="text-muted-foreground">To</dt>
          <dd className="font-mono">0x71C7…976F</dd>
        </div>
        <div className="flex justify-between">
          <dt className="text-muted-foreground">Network fee</dt>
          <dd className="tabular-nums">~$0.42</dd>
        </div>
      </dl>
      <SlideToConfirm
        label="Slide to send"
        confirmingLabel="Sending"
        doneLabel="Sent"
        onConfirm={() => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1200))}
        className="max-w-none"
      />
    </div>
  )
}
